data.title: 小鞠知花 · 文学社活动室的书本后偷牵手
data.description: 夕阳昏黄的文学社活动室桌前，知花立起书本挡在身前。在桌面投下的阴影中，少女小手颤颤巍巍地伸出，轻轻握住你的小拇指，羞得整张小脸埋在开衫领口里。
data.location: quiet old clubroom filled with dusty books and sunset light
data.action: sitting at clubroom table behind an open book, shyly reaching out under table to hold partner pinky finger, blushing furiously with twin braids trembling
data.lighting: warm amber sunset rays casting long soft shadows across wooden desk
data.mood: shy heart-thumping romance, quiet literary intimacy, sweet innocent tension
data.promptProse: Sitting at a dusty clubroom desk at sunset behind an open book, Chika Komari blushes intensely as she shyly holds partner finger with trembling brown eyes.
data.animaCaption: Chika Komari shyly holding partner hand behind book at sunset.
